description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class (JobCategoryAPI) within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It implements CRUD operations for managing job categories, including methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting job categories via RESTful API calls. The class uses various service and model classes, and includes API documentation annotations (OpenAPI) for its endpoints.

classes.name: JobCategoryAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing JobCategory entities within the OrangeHRM system, providing CRUD operations with validation and API documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single JobCategory by its ID, returning the data wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult. Throws RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of JobCategory entities with optional sorting and pagination parameters, returning an EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new JobCategory entity based on request data and returns it wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing JobCategory entity identified by ID, returning the updated entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple JobCategory entities based on provided IDs, returning the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Helper method to set the name on a JobCategory entity from request data and save it via the service.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the 'name' parameter, including uniqueness constraint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the 'id' parameter is positive.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validation rules for the getAll method, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a JobCategory, primarily validating 'name'.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a JobCategory, including 'id' and 'name' with a uniqueness check.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting JobCategories, primarily the list of IDs.
